title: audits.json
description: Full shape of data/audits.json: a protected location registry plus an append-only audit history. See docs/JSON_SCHEMA.md for the full explanation and docs/WEEKLY_AUDIT_GUIDE.md for how to add a new audit run.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last commit to this file. Bump this every time you append an entry.

practices.description: PROTECTED. The two general practices. Do not add, remove, rename, or re-id these outside of a deliberate, reviewed change — see data/registry-lock.json.

locations.description: PROTECTED. The 14-location registry, its expected appointment types, and scheduler URLs. Do not add, remove, or edit outside of a deliberate, reviewed change — see data/registry-lock.json. The weekly audit process must never write to this array.

auditHistory.description: APPEND-ONLY. Every completed audit run, ever. New entries are pushed to the end (or anywhere — order doesn't matter, the dashboard sorts by checkedAt); existing entries must never be edited or removed.
